name: Ferruginous-Bajada
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past a tidally locked hemisphere, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.

There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure. The only confirmed life is microbial, a chemosynthetic film that glows faintly where the ground weeps warmth.
the exotic matter deposit bends the local reality in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
Whoever solves this anomaly will rewrite several sciences. Whoever blunders into it will merely end several careers.
